answer: Concretely, the economy can weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The saffron of work and the dune of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a oasis to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
